annotations.title: Add UAE Federal Government Working Days

description:
Use this when you need a deterministic UAE federal-government offset inside 2026. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need a private employer, local-government or future-year calendar.
What it computes: Adds or subtracts dates using the exact 2026 UAE federal-government holiday package and Monday-Friday baseline.
Example user requests: Add five UAE federal-government working days after 2026-08-27.
Inputs: start_date (date); working_days (integer).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-08-27","working_days":1}
Outputs: start_date, result_date, working_days_added, calendar_days_elapsed, public_holidays_skipped, territory, territory_name, jurisdiction, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_legal_bases, calendar_scope, private_sector_policy, unresolved_lunar_rules, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: move one day at a time; decrement remaining only when UAE federal status.is_working_day=true
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/uae-federal-add-working-days with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/uae-federal-add-working-days.md

working_days.description: Signed offset; start date is excluded for non-zero offsets.

name: add_uae_federal_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: UAE federal-government workweek and national public holidays.

day_type.description: Regular workday, official weekend or public holiday.

holiday_legal_bases.description: Government announcement or Cabinet Resolution basis.

holiday_names.description: Exact-date public holidays applying on the date.

sources.description: Official UAE Government, legislation and FAHR sources.

unresolved_lunar_rules.description: Rules still awaiting an official Gregorian date, if any.

weekend_days.description: Saturday and Sunday for the federal-government baseline.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.
